comment: Model files shipped inside the installer (bundle.resources, see app/src-tauri/tauri.bundle-models.conf.json). Fetched into app/src-tauri/bundled-models/ by app/scripts/fetch-bundled-models.mjs before a release build (an entry with a url is downloaded; one with a path is copied from this models/ folder, where the file is committed). A Rust test (bundled_models.rs) checks every entry against the constants the app verifies models with, so this list cannot drift from them. Each file names its model family (denoise, segment, detect, inpaint, upscale, blink); `editions` lists, per edition, the families a build may use (an allow-list, so a family added later is never in a restricted edition by accident; `face` has no file because YuNet and SFace are downloaded). app/scripts/fetch-bundled-models.mjs --edition <name> (or EMULSION_EDITION) bundles only that edition's files and writes bundled-models.edition.json beside them; editions.rs checks the lists against the code. `default` must list every family. `store` is the Mac App Store edition (ADR-0011). `test-no-lama` is a fixture for the mechanism (RFC-0038 slice 4, ADR-0012), not a product edition.

default.comment: Every model: what every build has shipped so far.

store.comment: The Mac App Store edition (ADR-0011): the families whose weights the licence research of 2026-11-18 rated safe for a paid closed build. A `channel-mas` binary always resolves to this edition.

test-no-lama.comment: Fixture for the edition mechanism: the default without the object-removal model. Not a product decision.
